thesisSummary: Granite Ridge Bio Ventures Fund II leads $3-10M seed and Series A rounds in new immuno-oncology therapeutics companies. It favors platforms for solid tumors that overcome the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment, checkpoint-inhibitor non-response, CAR T failure in solid tumors, or the systemic toxicity of IL-12 and STING agonists. It invests from late preclinical (animal efficacy plus an IND plan within about two years) through Phase 1, and requires an exclusive license to issued patents or published applications; diagnostics, devices, digital health, autoimmune disease, animal health and non-therapeutics are excluded.
